احتفلتما (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَلْتُمَا (iḥtafaltumā) /iħ.ta.fal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# اُحْتُفِلْتُمَا (uḥtufiltumā) /uħ.tu.fil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
